region: Northern NJ — Bergen/Hudson Gold Coast + GWB corridor
tier_note: Real NJ MOD-IV parcel data. Max offer is the residual land value at the town's assumed density; the asking proxy is ASSESSED value (NJ ratios vary by town, so headroom here is relative, not absolute). The redevelopment/PILOT flag is the strategic edge.

assumptions.density_note: Units assume a per-town multifamily density (waterfront high-rise towns higher). VERIFY zoning/redevelopment plan — NJ waterfront zoning ranges from low-rise to high-rise by block.
assumptions.value_note: NJ NET_VALUE is ASSESSED value at each town's equalization ratio — NOT market. Useful as a relative within-town signal; multiply by the town ratio for market. Verify.
assumptions.note: Screen tier on real NJ MOD-IV parcel data. Redevelopment/PILOT flag is strategic — verify against the municipal redevelopment map.

build.note: Owner-builder costs (principal acts as GC). Third-party GC adds ~15-18% to hard cost.

residual_assumptions.note: Residual land value = net sale revenue (after 6% selling cost and 15% profit) minus owner-builder construction. Max offer is the land price at which the project still earns the target margin. Verify zoning, sewer, wetlands before offering.
